bullets.section: Tech trick I’m beyond excited to have discovered
bullets.title: Sort by unread messages in iMessage
bullets.note:
This has reduced my device anxiety tremendously. I get a lot of texts but will often lose unread messages several scrolls down and forget about them, disappointing a friend or losing a fun opportunity in the process. Last week, I was hanging out with a bunch of tech-savvy friends, and I noticed that one of them had an “Unread Messages” folder in iMessage. WTF?! I’d been begging Apple for this feature for years but had never seen it. He suggested it was because I hadn’t updated my iOS, but all of us were up-to-date, and he was the only one with this amazing folder on his phone. After some detective work, my friend Matt figured out how to implement it (Settings > Messages, then scroll down to Message Filtering, then turn on Filter Unknown Senders. In the Messages conversation list, tap Filters, then tap Unread Messages), and you can find [the step-by-step instructions here](https://support.apple.com/en-us/guide/iphone/iphe9b48b89e/ios). Thanks, Apple! I’d also love to request the ability to archive messages in iMessage, but being able to sort by unread is at least half the battle. Special thanks to JZ and Matt!  
​  
P.S. iOS 17 has [a slew of new iMessage features](https://www.cnet.com/tech/services-and-software/apples-new-ios-17-messages-features-help-it-catch-up-to-chat-apps/) coming in September, and one I am excited about is automatic transcription of voice memos. Also, don’t forget that you can now mark iMessage messages as “unread” by swiping right on them and tapping the blue magic…

bullets.creator: Ari Shaffir
bullets.note: ([@arishaffir](https://www.instagram.com/arishaffir)), available [for free on YouTube](https://youtu.be/y2YtIBYM4w0). This special will offend everyone, and I think that’s kinda the point. I and my friends, including Jewish friends, found this HILARIOUS, and I actually learned a ton while laughing my ass off. To make a show like this feel like a casual conversation requires superhuman effort, and Ari nailed it. מזל טוב!
